title: Soliton and breather resolution for the cubic Szegö flow on the line
summary: We investigate the long time behaviour of the solutions of the cubic Szeg}o equation on the line in the Sobolev space H^{1/2}(R). We prove that, for every datum of which the Lax operator has simple positive spectrum, the solution asymptotically decouples as an infinite sum of traveling quasi-periodic breather solutions. Under an additional generic condition on the data, we prove that these traveling breather solutions are in fact soliton solutions, leading to a soliton resolution theorem.
